title: Round 6 stream D: BELOW's quadcopter controls back: the body tilts from the keys alone (no bank from a turn), the chase camera's pitch clamped to [-0.75, +0.3], the start card says the flight keys
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, note 5 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-6-five-notes-design.md, stream D): 'Isao's controls in the last mission (BELOW) changed from a quadcopter scheme to something I do not recognise; the mouse makes the entire Isao flip sideways: bring back quadcopter controls.' The scout found the keys unchanged since the owner's 2026-10-16 drone scheme (W/S thrust along the heading, A/D and left/right turn in place, Space/Shift up and down, up/down arrows the camera's pitch). Branch round-6-below off 9f0eab02; the cave in kai-denrei/stalheart-cave, branch round-6-below off round-5-below, re-imported with scripts/import-below.mjs.
outcome: MEASURED FIRST (scratch measure-flip.mjs, the base cave in a detached worktree, headless on 18184 under the lock): from the throat (s 12) and the shaft, W held for 1 s, then a 2.4 rad/s mouse-x turn for 20 frames, at twelve camera pitches from -1.565 to +1.565. Before: the body rolled 0.246 rad at EVERY pitch (the tilt came from the world-frame acceleration, so the turn's sideways acceleration banked it); the camera's orbit pitch went to the full ±1.565: at +1.565 the camera sat 4.4 m under ISAO at -82 degrees, his belly and the cave turned over; at -1.565 it sat straight over him at 84 degrees, the world spinning with the yaw. A real CDP mouse drag reached -1.03 and +0.17 from the start pitch -0.43 (the mouse's y is live). That is the owner's flip: a bank from the mouse's x and a camera that swings under or over. NOW (cave 0de7405): (b) the tilt is the keyed command's alone (src/flight.js TILT {limit 0.32, rate 5}): pitch -0.32 x forward, roll -0.32 x right (right is 0 in the game, no strafe since 2026-10-16), eased at rate 5; a hover is level and a turn banks nothing. (a) the chase camera's orbit pitch is clamped by chasePitch to CHASE {above -0.75, below +0.3} for the mouse, the arrow keys and the ?test look() hook. After, same probe: roll 0 at every pitch; every pitch past a bound shows the bound's frame; the CDP drag stops at -0.75 and +0.3. Why these numbers: -0.75 keeps the camera 3.8 m over him at 44 degrees down, the floor, the flares and his work light still read, -0.9 and beyond tip toward the top-down view where the yaw spins the frame; +0.3 holds the camera 0.95 m under his level at 10 degrees up, still a side view; the design's +0.55 put it 2.06 m under at 24 degrees up, his underside filling the frame, which is the 'never under him' the design wanted to keep out. (c) the words: the start card's second line 'W S FLY · A D TURN · SPACE SHIFT UP DOWN · MOUSE LOOK' (mission.js FLIGHT_KEYS, its own span #mission-flight), the pause help (the wrong 'WASD controls horizontal flight'), README's control table, prose and the browser-check line. (d) the dead lookDelta removed, and the clamp import it left unused. The cave's two captures that looked at -1.5 and -1.2 now look at the clamp.
alternatives: Keep the acceleration-based tilt and only zero its roll: rejected; the along-heading part still moves with a turn (the velocity's projection on the new heading changes), and the design asked for the command alone, the angle-mode drone the owner described.
The design's +0.55 for the camera's lower bound: overturned after the frames; at +0.55 the camera is 2 m under ISAO, the read the owner called a flip. +0.3 keeps a slight look up.
Clamping only the mouse and leaving the ?test look() hook free: rejected; the harness would show views the player cannot reach.
evidence: scratch r6-below/frames-before and frames-after (24 frames each, report.json with roll, body pitch, camera height and elevation per pitch; contact sheets sheet-before-*.jpg / sheet-after-*.jpg)

cave test/flight.test.mjs: a turn alone, standing or moving against a twin flying straight, rolls 0 and leaves the pitch; W -0.32, S +0.32, a hover levels; chasePitch clamps both ends and a long drag stops on the bound. test/mission.test.mjs: the card's second line. Cave npm test 53/53, npm run check.

cave scripts/browser-test.mjs on its base and after: stops at nursery.tentacles 60 vs 64, stale on the base (round 5); the start card's pin (now with the flight line), keyboard flight, Shift/Space and the shaft capture at the clamp pass before it

game: npm test (321 programs), npm run check, npm run architecture (td-tab 5,357 under 5,450, untouched); --descent-carcass on 18184 with a new assert that the cave's start card shows FLIGHT_KEYS after TAKE THE FEED
